facts: Subash Chandra Panda, Kunja Ramana, Narayan Mazumdar, and Kalpana Mazumdar are facing death penalty for kidnapping and murder of a child Ranjeet Mohanty @ Rana.
The charge against them is of kidnapping and murder of a child under Sections 364, 302, and 201 read with 34 IPC.
The First Information Report was registered at the instance of Chitranajan Mohanty, PW7.
According to the FIR, the four appellants and Simanchal Padhi had kidnapped his nephew on April 30th, 1997, and subsequently killed him.
issues: Whether the conviction is sustainable based on the sole testimony of an accomplice without any corroboration.
Whether the investigation was satisfactory and whether the prosecution has established a motive for the accused to commit the crime.
petitioner_arguments: The submission urged before the Additional Sessions Judge and the High Court that PW14 was an accomplice and was not a witness to the offence was not accepted.
PW14 was held to be a mere mute spectator.
It would be highly unsafe to rely upon the testimony of PW14 and convict the appellants.
respondent_arguments: The prosecution rested its case entirely on PW14 without any corroboration of his testimony on any of the material aspects.
court_reasoning: It is not safe to convict the appellants on the sole testimony of PW14.
Without going into the question whether PW14 was an accomplice or not, it is evident that investigation of the case has been most tardy and unsatisfactory.
The prosecution did not explain what happened to the articles seized from the house of A2.
holding: The conviction is unsustainable based on the sole testimony of an accomplice without any corroboration.
The investigation was not satisfactory, and the prosecution has not established a motive for the accused to commit the crime.
